messages:
Ethan (ENG-MGR): Quick Q: we want to promote Yuki (London) to L4 with comp uplift and spot bonus, effective 2026-07-01. Is there anything special for international folks?
Priya (People Ops): short version: yes  a few extra fields for international payroll + tax withholding. also spot bonuses have separate approval + tax treatment per country.
Ethan (ENG-MGR): ugh ok what exactly do you need for Yuki so we can avoid a million emails?
Lydia (People Ops Ops): Required in the packet: manager rationale (3 bullets), 2 concrete contributions (links + 1-line context), peer feedback excerpt, proposed comp (base, bonus %, spot bonus amt), PeopleSoft ID or local payroll ID, employee country, bank currency, requested effective date, and manager sign-off.
Rocio (Payroll-Intl): Add: employee national insurance / NI number for UK, tax code, and residency status. If spot bonus > 1 month salary we may need additional forms for tax withholding.
Sam (Compensation): If the new base pushes them above band max we need comp-exception + sign-off from compensation director. For international employees include band equivalent reasoning (local bands vary).
Ethan (ENG-MGR): Can we expedite for a 7/1 effective date if we submit materials next Monday?
Priya (People Ops): Possibly. Expedited requests need a note in the packet and approval from People Ops lead. Payroll still needs physical cutoffs: for UK payroll cutoff for July pay is two weeks prior. If you need retro pay we'll need signed comp-change + all payroll fields before cutoff.
Ethan (ENG-MGR): spot bonus timing? want to align with promo month.
Rocio (Payroll-Intl): Spot bonus is usually paid in the payroll run following approval. If you want it same month as promo, we need approvals + forms by that payroll's cutoff. Also confirm pay currency to avoid FX issues.
Ethan (ENG-MGR): anything about visa / work authorization? Yuki is sponsored, sent transfer in last year.
Priya (People Ops): good catch. For sponsored employees confirm that the sponsored employment contract allows the new role/level change; include immigration case ID in packet. If title change impacts visa conditions, legal must sign off before effective date.
Sam (Compensation): practical tip: include a short "Comp alignment" bullet showing market comp data or peer comparators for London L4 to justify any band exceptions.
Ethan (ENG-MGR): how to announce? manager can tell privately?
Lydia (People Ops Ops): Manager 1:1 ok. Wait for People Ops confirmation before team-wide announcement or offer/notice email. hr-reminder-bot: Reminder: do not post public announcements until People Ops confirms payroll sync.
Priya (People Ops): Filename: promo_<FIRST>_<LAST>_<MGR>.pdf. Drop in HR Promotions folder and cc people-ops. If you want a pre-check, ping me 48h before submission.
Ethan (ENG-MGR): checklist pls so i can copy/paste into our hiring tracker
Lydia (People Ops Ops): ```
- Promo template (use London variant)
- Manager rationale (3 bullets)
- 2 contributions (links + 1-line context)
- Peer feedback excerpt
- Proposed comp (base, bonus %, spot bonus amt)
- Local payroll ID / PeopleSoft ID, NI / tax code, bank currency
- Immigration case ID (if sponsored)
- Manager sign-off + comp-exception note if > band max
- Indicate if expedited and desired payroll run
```
Ethan (ENG-MGR): thanks, will submit Friday.
Priya (People Ops): great  we'll review and flag any legal/payroll blockers. Closing thread.
